description: developer-harness guard hooks (Codex dialect). Two layers: safety guards on every shell tool call (dangerous shell commands, protected paths), then commit hygiene (secrets, large files, merge markers, quality gate). Codex has no per-command `if` narrowing, so every script no-ops fast when nothing relevant is staged, and quality-gate.sh additionally skips payloads that are not a `git commit`. Declared in .codex-plugin/plugin.json; deliberately NOT named hooks/hooks.json — see hooks/README.md. instruction-scan.sh, agents-md-budget.sh, and done-authority-gate.sh are documented opt-ins and are intentionally absent here.

hooks.statusMessage: quality-gate: running fast checks on staged languages
